messages:
olivia: ACME sent back the security questionnaire this morning. Key asks: 2yr immutable audit retention, KMS rotation with HSM attestation, tenant-scoped RBAC evidence for service accounts, and a 48h vuln triage SLA. Can we scope answers + an action plan?

mike: Link to the Q here: https://acme.example/q/12345. Quick take: we can meet most asks but some need infra work (immutable chain for request-level payloads, HSM attestation). RBAC exports + audit logs are doable. 48h triage is currently tight (we do 72h), need sales signoff for enterprise SLA.

sam: For the immutable audit-chain we can produce signed snapshots and a hash chain. Playbook exists — see internal runbook. Export command we use now: `bin/export-logs --start 2026-01-01 --end now --format ndjson --tenant acme`

rachel: On KMS: we envelope tenant data keys and store them. Rotation is a background re-encryption job. We support BYOK (customer-managed CMKs); HSM attestation depends on provider and key type. Need to confirm whether ACME requires attestation report or key provenance docs.

mike: Proposed action items: 1) confirm HSM attestation path with infra/cloud; 2) assemble RBAC evidence (role->svcacct mapping + signed audit); 3) implement/confirm immutable logchain snapshots & retention config; 4) negotiate 48h vuln SLA for paid enterprise.

olivia: @sec-bot can you attach the last audit export and the retention policy doc? Will help with the questionnaire answers.

sec-bot: attached: /playbooks/audit-log-export.md — contains export steps + verification. Most recent export: export-2026-02-28-acme-ndjson.gz (5.2GB). Reminder: check ACLs before sharing :lock:

sam: role/export snippet for RBAC evidence (we can run and redact emails):
```sql
SELECT role, member, assigned_at
FROM rbac.assignments
WHERE tenant_id = 'acme'
ORDER BY assigned_at DESC;
```
We can sign the CSV with a GPG key and include MD5/SHA256 of the signed file for chain-of-custody.

rachel: Example KMS policy we can show (will swap ARNs to customer's CMK):
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-tenant-enc"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:ReEncrypt*","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/EXAMPLE"}]}
```
We should also include a short description of our envelope flow and re-encrypt job (idempotent, retries, rate-limited).

mike: Can each of you produce the specific evidence by EOD tomorrow? I'll own compiling the packet and the questionnaire draft. I'll also loop in sales for SLA language.

sam: ETA on artifacts: logs export/runbook ready in 3 days; signed snapshot procedure + test 1 day; full re-encrypt dry-run ~5 days; full-run depends on size but initial estimate for ACME ~6-8h once staged.

rachel: I'll start KMS policy docs + rotation notes. HSM attestation: cloud provider reply typically 2-3 business days; we can mark that as pending with interim mitigations.

olivia: Good plan. I'll draft responses and flag pending items. Please drop any blockers here. :thumbsup:
